definition: Able to quickly and cleverly work out how to solve a problem.
examples: He's quite resourceful. He can usually work out how to solve a problem. [1]

definition: Executing something with great attention to detail.
examples: He's very thorough. Whatever part of a job he's doing, he does it with great attention to detail. [1]

definition: Intelligent and quick to learn.
examples: My nieces are both really bright. They get very good marks at school in all their subjects. [1]

definition: Honest, open, and saying just what one thinks.
examples: She's such a straightforward person. She's honest and open and says just what she thinks. [1]

definition: Having made a firm decision and not letting anything stop you.
examples: She's very determined. Once she's decided to do something, nothing will stop her. [1]

definition: Never needing anyone else's help.
examples: He's very self-sufficient. He never needs anyone else's help. [1]

definition: Showing care, understanding, and compassion for someone else's suffering.
examples: He's not very sympathetic. When I was ill last week, he didn't even phone me. [1]

definition: Wishing to do what is right, working hard to make sure everything gets done.
examples: She is so conscientious! She worked all weekend to make sure she got everything done. [1]

definition: Calm, kind, and rarely getting angry.
examples: My sister's a very gentle person. She's calm and kind and she never gets angry. [1]

definition: Sensible and reliable.
examples: Her boyfriend is a steady kind of guy. He's sensible and she can really rely on him. [1]

definition: Able to act on sudden decisions without planning.
examples: He's very spontaneous. He can suddenly decide to go to Paris in the morning and in the evening he's there! [1]

definition: Using irony to mock or convey contempt, often making people feel small.
examples: Our maths teacher used to be so sarcastic. She loved making comments that made us feel small. [1]

definition: To regularly or frequently behave in a particular way.
examples: My father tends to avoid conflict – he never argues with my mother, he just leaves the room. [1]

definition: What appears to be true or visible from the outside.
examples: On the surface he seems self-confident, but deep down he's quite insecure. [1]

definition: What a person really feels or is like inside, contrary to their outward appearance.
examples: On the surface he seems self-confident, but deep down he's quite insecure. [1]

definition: To make a particular impression on others.
examples: He comes across as quite sarcastic, but in fact he's really friendly. [1]

definition: To be extremely kind, gentle, and generous.
examples: My dad's got a heart of gold. He's the gentlest person I know. [1]

definition: To be very sensible and practical.
translation: Con los pies en la tierra
examples: My brother-in-law is very down to earth. He's very sensible and practical. [1]

definition: Someone who is unfriendly and never shows their emotions.
examples: My boss is a bit of a cold fish. She's unfriendly and she never shows her emotions. [1]

term: A real pain in the neck
definition: Someone who is very annoying.
translation: Un pesado / Un dolor de cabeza
examples: My brother's a real pain in the neck. He's so annoying – he's always taking my things. [1]

definition: A person who is easily persuaded or manipulated, especially to give money.
translation: Un trozo de pan / Alguien fácil de convencer
examples: My mum's a soft touch. I can always persuade her to give me extra pocket money. [1]

definition: Thinking that you are the most important person.
examples: I know I shouldn't criticise your family, but your sister is really full of herself. She thinks she's the most important member of the family. [1]

definition: Incredibly kind to everyone and not aggressive at all.
translation: Incapaz de matar a una mosca
examples: He comes across as aggressive, but in fact he wouldn't hurt a fly. He's incredibly kind to everyone he meets. [1]

term: The life and soul of the party
definition: Someone who is very energetic and funny, great at telling jokes and making people laugh.
examples: My cousin's always the life and soul of the party. She's great at telling jokes and making people laugh. [1]
